subject: Gems of Rod — Demande de disponibilité et tarifs : saphirs du Cachemire & alexandrite
body:
Dear Sarah,

I hope this message finds you well. This is the Gems of Rod team writing — the French gem house you have worked with previously on Kashmir sapphires and Brazilian alexandrite.

Our clients continue to show strong interest in two of the categories you source particularly well:

- Natural, unheated Kashmir sapphires (2–4 ct range, GIA certification preferred)
- Colour-change alexandrite with a strong green-to-red shift (1–2 ct range)

Could you kindly share your current availability and indicative pricing for these categories? As always, we would appreciate stones accompanied by GIA certification and, where possible, an origin report.

We are looking to place an order in the coming weeks, so any recent acquisitions you could share photos or lab reports for would be very helpful.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

With our sincere regards,
The Gems of Rod Team
